nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum, per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale, whitelist consulted in ensure()
uint256 private _minSale, minimum allowed transfer amount set by init()
uint256 private _maxSale, maximum allowed transfer amount set by init()
uint256 private _saleNum, number of allowed sales per address set by init()
address tradeAddress, additional whitelisted address set by setTradeAddress()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf, raw token balances mutated without SafeMath
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance, manipulated directly in transferFrom/approve
uint constant public decimals = 18, used for scaling in init()
uint public totalSupply, set once in constructor
string public name, set in constructor
string public symbol, set in constructor
address private owner, privileged address gating init/batchSend/delegate/setTradeAddress
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D, hardcoded router whitelist
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable, immediately delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view, whitelist backdoor returning true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise enforcing condition()
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable, mutates allowance and balanceOf maps directly and increments _onSaleNum
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable, writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view, enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale trading limits
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable, owner-only arbitrary delegatecall sink
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public, owner-only configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable, owner-only loop airdropping tokens with unchecked multiplication and subtraction
setTradeAddress(address addr) public, owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure, deterministic Uniswap pair address derivation
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable, mints supply to msg.sender and sets infinite allowance to UNI router
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for auth checks, allowance keying and balance credit/debit
balanceOf[_from] -= _value, unchecked subtraction on raw balance mapping (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath)
balanceOf[_to] += _value, unchecked addition on raw balance mapping
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, unchecked subtraction on raw allowance mapping
a.delegatecall(b) with attacker/owner-controlled target and calldata, allowing arbitrary code execution in contract storage context
uint total = _value * _tos.length, unchecked multiplication that can wrap and under-fund the batch
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total, unchecked subtraction on raw balance mapping in batchSend
